title: 力德科技：海外人形机器人，已批量供货，哪些客户在测试？
speaker: Angle Jagan

segments.en: Actually we are the major supplier of many top domestic human robot companies including Agibot which ranked the first globally in the shipments of human robot last year,
segments.zh: 实际上，我们是多家国内头部人形机器人公司的主要供应商，包括去年全球出货量第一的智元机器人。

segments.en: and also for re-intelligence, Galaxia, Axe humanoid, etc.
segments.zh: 还有睿智能、银河通用、艾克斯等公司。

segments.en: And as you mentioned, actually we're in touch with many overseas human robot companies and we've actually provided them with samples for testing
segments.zh: 正如你提到的，我们与许多海外人形机器人公司有接触，并已向他们提供样品进行测试。

segments.en: and for some of them we have already started to supply volume.
segments.zh: 其中一些公司，我们已经开始批量供货。
